objects.description: A simple utility class that maintains an exponential moving average of double values. It stores a smoothing factor, the current average, and whether an average has been initialized. Users add samples via addValue; average returns the current EMA; setSmoothingFactor adjusts the weighting; clear resets the state. Destructor, copy/move semantics, and thread-safety details are not specified in the header.

functions.name: ExponentialMovingAverage::ExponentialMovingAverage
functions.description: Default constructor for an ExponentialMovingAverage instance. Creates an object with no initial value and an unspecified smoothing factor. Typical usage is to default-construct, then immediately set the smoothing factor via setSmoothingFactor() before adding values.
requirements: Object must be constructed before use.
After default construction, the caller should set the smoothing factor via setSmoothingFactor(double) before calling addValue(double), to avoid using an indeterminate smoothing factor.
Thread-safety and concurrency guarantees are unknown.

functions.name: ExponentialMovingAverage::ExponentialMovingAverage
functions.description: Constructor that initializes an ExponentialMovingAverage with the provided smoothing factor. Use when the smoothing factor is known at construction time, then feed samples with addValue() and query via average().
requirements: Object must be constructed before use.
The semantics and valid range of smoothingFactor are not documented; typical EMA uses a value in (0,1], but the exact accepted range is unknown from this header.
Thread-safety and concurrency guarantees are unknown.

functions.name: ExponentialMovingAverage::average
functions.description: Returns the current exponential moving average. If no values have been added yet, the behavior is not documented; based on member initialization, it may return 0 until a first value is added, but this is not guaranteed by the header.
requirements: May be called on a const instance.
If called before any values are added, the returned value and semantics are not documented; callers should be prepared for a default or initial value.

functions.name: ExponentialMovingAverage::setSmoothingFactor
functions.description: Sets the smoothing factor used by the exponential moving average for subsequent updates. Intended to be called before adding values, especially when using the default constructor.
requirements: Should be called before addValue(double) when the object was default-constructed, to ensure a defined smoothing factor is used.
Effect on an already-accumulated average is not documented; callers should assume it affects future updates only.
The valid range and constraints for smoothingFactor are not documented.

functions.name: ExponentialMovingAverage::addValue
functions.description: Feeds a new sample into the exponential moving average and updates the internal average using the current smoothing factor.
requirements: A valid smoothing factor should have been established either via the smoothing-factor constructor or by calling setSmoothingFactor(double) prior to the first call.
Input value type is double; no further constraints are documented (e.g., NaN/Inf handling is unspecified).
No error reporting (return value/exceptions) is specified.

functions.name: ExponentialMovingAverage::clear
functions.description: Resets the internal state of the exponential moving average. Typically clears any accumulated average so that subsequent addValue() calls start a new series.
requirements: Can be called at any time; exact effects on internal fields (e.g., resetting average to 0 and hasValue to false) are inferred from member defaults but not explicitly documented.
After clear(), callers should assume the next addValue() behaves like the first sample of a new sequence.
